tool.name: IMAGINE-X subhkl Finder-Less Solve (Lattice Ladder)
tool.description: Threshold-free Lattice-Ladder orientation search and staged zone-band / Poisson geometry refinement

ln -sf "$scan" "$scan.element_identifier" &&
#set $options = " --refinement " + str($refinement) + " --instrument " + str($instrument) + " "
#if str($dMin) not in ('', 'None', 'Not available.'): #set $options = $options + " --d-min " + str($dMin) + " " #end if #if str($seed) not in ('', 'None', 'Not available.'): #set $options = $options + " --search-seed " + str($seed) + " " #end if #if str($a) not in ('', 'None', 'Not available.') and str($b) not in ('', 'None', 'Not available.') and str($c) not in ('', 'None', 'Not available.'): #set $_alpha = str($alpha) if str($alpha) not in ('', 'None', 'Not available.') else '90.0' #set $_beta = str($beta) if str($beta) not in ('', 'None', 'Not available.') else '90.0' #set $_gamma = str($gamma) if str($gamma) not in ('', 'None', 'Not available.') else '90.0' #set $options = $options + " --cell '" + str($a) + "," + str($b) + "," + str($c) + "," + $_alpha + "," + $_beta + "," + $_gamma + "' " #end if #if str($spaceGroup) not in ('', 'None', 'Not available.'): #set $options = $options + " --space-group '" + str($spaceGroup) + "' " #end if #if str($wavelengthMin) not in ('', 'None', 'Not available.'): #set $options = $options + " --wavelength-min " + str($wavelengthMin) + " " #end if #if str($wavelengthMax) not in ('', 'None', 'Not available.'): #set $options = $options + " --wavelength-max " + str($wavelengthMax) + " " #end if #if str($runs) not in ('', 'None', 'Not available.'): #set $options = $options + " --runs '" + str($runs) + "' " #end if #if str($stableRuns) not in ('', 'None', 'Not available.'): #set $options = $options + " --stable-runs '" + str($stableRuns) + "' " #end if #if $staticMaskFile: ln -sf "$staticMaskFile" "$staticMaskFile.element_identifier" && #set $options = $options + " --static-mask-file '" + str($staticMaskFile.element_identifier) + "' " #end if #if $finderFile: ln -sf "$finderFile" "$finderFile.element_identifier" && #set $options = $options + " --finder-peaks '" + str($finderFile.element_identifier) + "' " #end if

python -m subhkl.io.parser solve "$scan.element_identifier" out/solve.h5 $options && python -m subhkl.io.parser rainbow-visualize out/solve.h5 --images "$scan.element_identifier" --instrument "$instrument" -o out/rainbow_zones.html && chmod -R a+rwX out

param.name: scan
param.label: Reduced / Merged Image Stack or Shared Pointer (scan.ref.json / merged.h5)

param.label: Override Resolution Limit d_min (Å) (blank for subhkl default)

param.name: runs
param.label: Selected Run Indices (comma-separated, blank for all)

param.name: stableRuns

param.name: modes

param.name: nZones
param.label: Override Number of Direct-Lattice Zones in Fine Band Stage

param.name: bandBinning
param.label: Override Band Observation Spatial Binning (blank for subhkl auto default)

param.name: samples
param.label: Override Blind Search Quadrature Samples (blank for subhkl default)

param.name: candidates
param.label: Override Distinct Lattice-Ladder Orientation Candidates (blank for subhkl default)

param.name: maxiter
param.label: Override Max L-BFGS-B Iterations per Band Stage

param.name: poissonBinning
param.label: Override Poisson Solve Spatial Binning (blank for subhkl default)

param.name: proposalBinning
param.label: Override Poisson Proposal Spatial Binning (blank for subhkl default)

param.name: nOrientations
param.label: Override Poisson Retained Candidate Orientations (blank for subhkl default)

param.name: finderFile
param.label: Optional Peak Finder File (leave empty for finder-less solve)

param.name: seed
param.label: Override Random Seed (blank for subhkl default)

tool.help:
**IMAGINE-X subhkl Finder-Less Solve (`lattice_ladder` + Staged Zone-Band / Poisson Refinement)**
Determines crystal orientation `U`, reciprocal-lattice metric `B`, per-run goniometer corrections, and calibrated detector bank geometry directly from reduced/merged detector images (`scan.h5` / `merged.h5`) without requiring a peak-finder threshold:
1. **Step 1 — Binned Count Excess**: Smooth $\chi^2$-suppressed Poisson deviance weights on detector count bins. 2. **Step 2 — 13→145 Zone Lattice Ladder**: Coarse SO(3) Funk table on 13 fundamental zones followed by zoom-and-prune rungs across 30, 60, and 145 zones. 3. **Step 3 — 60-Zone Global Band**: Co-refines global detector geometry (`cylindrical`, `axial_stretch`, `global_rot`, `global_trans`) and 3D orientation. 4. **Step 4 — 120→400 Zone + Cell**: Multi-run band refinement with per-run $\omega$ drift and unit-cell ratios. 5. **Step 5 — Converged Solve UB**: Final Ewald reflection polish and interactive HTML5 Diffraction Parallax diagnostic.
